brand.purpose: The wordmark only — one element per screen.

label.purpose: Panel labels in uppercase mono; the instrument's engraved markings.

data.purpose: Every equation, constant, and readout — always tabular.

body.purpose: Descriptive prose inside panels; never for numbers.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Button/tab hover and active state changes — fast like hardware.

components.name: Button
components.description: Square instrument key; orange when the state it toggles is active.
components.css: .ds-btn { appearance: none; background: #131311; border: 1px solid #222220; color: #ededec; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 5px 10px; cursor: pointer; border-radius: 0; transition: background-color 80ms linear, border-color 80ms linear, color 80ms linear; } .ds-btn:hover { background: #1a1a17; border-color: #82827b; } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ff4f00; outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-btn-active, .ds-btn-active:hover { background: #ff4f00; border-color: #ff4f00; color: #080807; font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Field input
components.description: Carbon well for equations, names, and numeric values.
components.css: .ds-input { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 12px; color: #ededec; background: #080807; border: 1px solid #222220; padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: 0; width: 220px; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #ff4f00; outline: none; }

components.name: Panel
components.description: Flat carbon workbench panel with an engraved mono label.
components.html:
State dimension (N)
First-order system dS/dt = f(S, P)
components.css: .ds-panel { background: #0c0c0b; border: 1px solid #222220; padding: 12px; border-radius: 0; max-width: 300px; } .ds-panel-label { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #ededec; margin-bottom: 4px; } .ds-panel-body { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 11px; color: #96968f; }

components.name: Tab
components.description: Workbench section tab with a keyboard hint.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; background: #080807; } .ds-tab { appearance: none; background: transparent; border: none; border-right: 1px solid #222220; padding: 10px 14px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 11px; color: #96968f; cursor: pointer; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 10px; } .ds-tab kbd { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 10px; color: #82827b; border: 1px solid #222220; padding: 0 3px; } .ds-tab-active { background: #131311; color: #ff4f00; font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Error banner
components.description: Inline expression-error report that names the problem.
components.html: Expression error"1k" is not a valid constant name — use letters, digits and underscores.
components.css: .ds-error { background: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.15); border-bottom: 1px solid #ef4444; padding: 8px 12px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 11px; color: #ef4444; display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 8px; } .ds-error-title { font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; flex-shrink: 0; }

narrative.overview: Phase Space looks like lab hardware, not a website: a full-viewport frame of flat carbon panels joined by 1px graphite seams, one saturated signal-orange voice for anything active or measured, and monospaced numerals wherever data lives. Depth does not exist as shadow — hierarchy comes from surface value, hairline borders, and typographic weight. Corners are square everywhere. Density is deliberately high, but every value sits at or above the 11px legibility floor and every constant is scrubable in place. The one moment of expressiveness is the simulation itself: colored trail integrations rendering inside a black WebGL viewport that occupies most of the frame.
keyCharacteristics: Flat carbon panel ladder (4 near-black steps) with 1px seams; zero shadows, zero radius
Signal orange (#ff4f00) as the single accent: active states, live values, focus rings, run state
JetBrains Mono for every number, equation, and label; Inter only for descriptive prose
Full-viewport app frame: bar / workbench / viewport / telemetry strip — never a scrolling page
The WebGL scene is the interface; chrome recedes to hairlines

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Signal orange never exceeds a sliver of any screen — one active transport button, a run dot, a few live numerals. Its rarity is what makes the instrument feel precise.

rules.name: The Seams Rule
rules.body: Panels separate with 1px Carbon 700 borders only. No shadow may ever substitute for a seam.

rules.name: The Data-in-Mono Rule
rules.body: Any number a visitor can read or edit is monospaced with tabular figures so it never shifts width while scrubbing.

dos: Do set every editable or displayed number in JetBrains Mono with tabular-nums.
Do reserve Signal orange for active/live/selected states and focus rings.
Do separate panels with 1px Carbon 700 seams and keep corners at 0 radius.
Do keep the frame at exactly 100vh — the page scrolls inside panels, never as a document.
donts: Don't introduce shadows, gradients, rounded corners, or glass/blur — the world is flat lab hardware.
Don't add a second accent hue; the channel colors (red/green/amber) exist only for axis/data semantics.
Don't set functional text below 11px (10px floor only for kbd hints and scope annotations).
Don't invent sci-fi system names or cosplay copy — labels name what the thing actually is.
